definitions.explanation: The ability to do something skillfully, smoothly, and efficiently. Refers to how well and quickly one handles tasks, especially practical or manual ones.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手際|てぎわ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: She cooked the meal skillfully and efficiently.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}くて→悪い：00908_warui⟧、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかって→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I was inefficient and it took too long.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ぶり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}した→感心：02559_kanshin⟧。
examples.english: I was impressed by the skillful way the work was done.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧/⟦よい→良い：02350_yoi⟧ (skillful, efficient, deft)
- {手際|てぎわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (clumsy, inefficient)
- {手際|てぎわ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ (skillfully, efficiently - adverb)
- ⟦{鮮|あざ}やかな→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧{手際|てぎわ} (brilliant/impressive skill)

USAGE:
{手際|てぎわ} emphasizes smooth, efficient execution—doing something without wasted motion or time.
- {手際|てぎわ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧ (to clean up efficiently)
- {手際|てぎわ}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こなす→こなす：09897_konasu⟧ (to handle work efficiently)
Often used for cooking, housework, crafts, and any practical tasks where efficiency and skill are valued.

WRITING:
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {際|ぎわ} (edge/skill) = skill with the hands

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧ (skill, ability - more about capability level)
- ⟦{手|て}さばき→手さばき：30146_tesabaki⟧ (dexterity, handling skill - especially with tools/objects)

cross_references.note: skill level rather than efficiency of execution
